tasks.title: Fix flaky test system_allowlist_bypasses_dlp_for_http using mock server
tasks.description: Replace external example.com dependency in tests/proxy_test.rs with local TCP mock server or wiremock crate to eliminate CI flakiness (R1-1)
tasks.details: Add wiremock as dev-dependency to Cargo.toml. In tests/proxy_test.rs, replace example.com with MockServer::start().await; mock_server.mock(|when, then| { when.any_request(); then.status(200); }); Use mock_server.uri() in proxy config. Ensure test binds to localhost only.

tasks.title: Implement chunked transfer-encoding support in MITM mode
tasks.description: Add chunked decoding logic for requests without Content-Length header in MITM proxy handler (R1-2)
tasks.details: In src/proxy/mitm.rs read_request_body function: if Content-Length missing and Transfer-Encoding: chunked, implement decode_chunked(stream, MAX_BODY_SIZE=10MB) using h2::recv::RecvStream or manual chunk parsing. Fallback to connection close with 10MB cap. Use tokio::io::AsyncReadExt for streaming.
tasks.testStrategy: 3개 단위 테스트 추가: 1) chunked body 정상 디코딩, 2) oversized chunked truncation, 3) mixed Content-Length+chunked 에러 처리. Integration test with curl --http1.1 --header 'Transfer-Encoding: chunked'

tasks.title: Improve expand_tilde() using dirs crate

tasks.testStrategy: 3개 단위 테스트: 1) ~/test → /home/user/test, 2) ~ → /home/user, 3) invalid ~nonexistent → 원본 반환. Cross-platform Windows/Linux/macOS 테스트.

tasks.title: Add audit logging configuration and DB schema migration
tasks.description: Implement opt-in audit logging with request_body and dlp_findings columns in SQLite (R3)
tasks.details: 1. Add LoggingConfig struct to src/config.rs with audit:bool, audit_max_body_size:usize=65536, audit_actions:Vec<String>. 2. In logging/mod.rs init_db(): check PRAGMA table_info(request_logs) for request_body column, if missing execute ALTER TABLE ADD COLUMN request_body TEXT; ADD COLUMN dlp_findings TEXT;. 3. Add audit_config:Option<LoggingConfig> to ConnectionContext.
tasks.testStrategy: Test DB migration on fresh/legacy DBs. Verify audit=false → no columns used, audit=true → body 저장. Test truncation at 64KB.
